briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 accelerate AGI timelines as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration on reasoning models while regulatory pressure mounts globally. US-China chip export tensions remain a key bottleneck for scaling.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with 12% gains on GPQA; Anthropic launched Claude 4.5 and Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1. DeepSeek R2 now leads on several Chinese benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines emphasize runtime monitoring for agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $15B expansion of its Texas supercluster; TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI chips. Google TPU v6 pods now online in three new regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols become the decisive layer in AGI safety or will raw scale dominate?
